Kwame, I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler rejected my request with "gateway cron requires credentials", so nothing is scheduled yet and no 09:00 digest will arrive tomorrow.

I checked what I need for it: you're a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it for you. The digest would cover new items since the previous run, share operational facts such as dates, seat counts, tickets and contacts, and leave out money terms and finance documents.

The fix is on the Gateway side: its scheduler needs auth configured. I haven't changed any config myself. Once an operator has fixed that, ask me again and I'll set up the 09:00 Chicago-time schedule from tomorrow. In the meantime, I can post a digest of #coastal-team here on request.
